mapper.sql: SELECT CAST(og.id AS CHAR) AS id, og.guest_name AS name, og.guest_name AS guestName, og.guest_mobile AS mobile, og.guest_mobile AS phone, og.guest_id_card AS idCard, og.guest_id_card AS cardNo, COALESCE(r.room_no, r.room_name, '') AS roomNo, COALESCE(ca.channel_name, CASE om.source_type WHEN 'frontdesk' THEN '前台' WHEN 'phone' THEN '电话' WHEN 'channel' THEN '渠道' ELSE COALESCE(om.source_type, '-') END ) AS channelName, COALESCE(ca.channel_name, CASE om.source_type WHEN 'frontdesk' THEN '前台' WHEN 'phone' THEN '电话' WHEN 'channel' THEN '渠道' ELSE COALESCE(om.source_type, '-') END ) AS orderSource, om.order_no AS orderNo, COALESCE(om.out_order_no, '') AS channelOrderNo, DATE_FORMAT(om.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS uploadTime, DATE_FORMAT(om.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS reportTime, '5' AS bizType, '0' AS state, '公安回执：待重新上报' AS remark, '公安回执：待重新上报' AS receiptMessage, CAST(om.poi_id AS CHAR) AS poiId
mapper.select: ORDER BY om.updated_at DESC, og.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
